استرخيت (form X)
# اِسْتَرْخَيْتُ (istarḵaytu) /is.tar.xaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَرْخَى (istarḵā)
# اِسْتَرْخَيْتَ (istarḵayta) /is.tar.xaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَرْخَى (istarḵā)
# اِسْتَرْخَيْتِ (istarḵayti) /is.tar.xaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَرْخَى (istarḵā)
